title: CUDA driver pin rotation & image ABI shimming orchestrator
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Problem: As we maintain multiple LTS channels we need a deterministic, auditable process to rotate pinned CUDA/driver combinations across container images without causing silent ABI regressions. Existing image pinning is ad-hoc (manual manifests + ops tickets) which creates drift between SBOMs, driver matrices, and actual deployed bundles. This ticket implements an orchestrator service and operator playbook that: 1) computes rotation cohorts, 2) validates image<>driver ABI compatibility using cross-version prober jobs, 3) emits SBOM delta checks and attestations, and 4) exposes rollout gates that integrate with canary cohorts for LTS channels.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator can compute pinset cohorts and output deterministic manifest revisions (signed) for an LTS channel
Automated cross-version prober runs (kernel/userland smoke tests) complete with pass/fail and link to artifacts
SBOM delta verification compares before/after images and flags unexpected binary additions/removals
Rollout gates exposed via console API: SAFE, REVIEW_REQUIRED, BLOCKED; and gate evaluation logs stored for audit
Runbook completed and tested: automated rollback triggers on gate failure and metrics thresholds
Integration test: perform a staged rotation on a non-prod LTS cohort (cohort A) and observe no client-visible regression
implementation_notes: High-level components: 1) cohort calculator (service) that ingests image catalog + driver compatibility matrix; 2) prober fleet that runs ephemeral pods across driver versions and collects ABI/KV cache integrity checks; 3) SBOM delta engine using existing attestation artifacts; 4) rollout-gate evaluator (policy engine) that exposes an API for Console/CI to query gate status. Use signed manifests to prevent drift. Prefer declarative CRD-style manifests for private deployments. Keep operator idempotent: re-run must not create new cohorts if inputs unchanged.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Staging: run cohort calculation against staging catalog; verify generated manifest signatures (2 engineers) - 2 days
Phase 1 - Canary: apply rotation to canary LTS cohort (1% of dedicated capacity) with prober watch - 3 days
Phase 2 - Gradual: expand cohorts by doubling size every 24h if gates pass - automated policy
Phase 3 - Complete: publish LTS channel manifest, update Console release page and release notes
Fallback: immediate automated rollback if gate flips to BLOCKED or if latency/cpu error budget throttles exceed configured thresholds
test_plan: Unit tests for cohort calculator: deterministic inputs -> deterministic outputs
Prober integration tests: run against three driver versions (current, prev, next) and assert ABI hash stability
SBOM delta tests: inject a synthetic unexpected binary and ensure delta flags a high-severity alert
E2E: run full rotation end-to-end on non-prod LTS cluster and compare traffic/error metrics vs baseline
Chaos test: simulate node driver rollback mid-rotation and assert orchestrator resumes to a safe state
monitoring: Alert: SBOM-delta-severity>=HIGH triggers on-call and blocks rollout
Dashboard: per-channel gate history with timestamps, signing key used, and linked artifacts
Tracing: end-to-end trace from cohort calculation -> prober -> gate evaluation for auditability
